sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :-
Sanjeev Kumar Trivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that they are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.
They have committed no offence and are marginal witnesses of alleged sale deeds those are six in number executed by Smt. Annapurna, the mother of the applicant no. 1 Subodh Kumar.

As per allegation in the F.I.R. Gata Nos. 328 and 349 were to be sold in favour of the informant for Rs. 30 lacs out of which Rs. 12 lacs were received by the father of the applicant no. 1 Subodh but sale deed could not be executed on account of stay order passed by Civil Judge,
Junior Division, Chhibramau.
After disposal of the order, sale deed was to be executed and remaining amount of Rs. 18 lacs was also to be paid at the time of execution of sale deed.

The stay Subodh Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151221573/
1 order was in operation but by concealing the fact, the aforesaid land was sold to six persons named in the F.I.R. by receiving consideration and without giving any information to the informant and without making repayment of the amount of Rs. 12 lacs received by them at the time of agreement to sell.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further submitted that applicants are only marginal witnesses and they have committed no offence.
They have also not received any consideration amount but it was received by the father of Subodh.
Applicant no. 2 Surendra Singh is friend of applicant no. 1 Subodh Kumar.
After investigation charge sheet has been submitted against them and they are ready to face the trial.
There is apprehension of arrest against the applicants, so reqeust for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.
On the other hand, learned AGA opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail and urged that in this case applicants cannot be said to be innocent.

Applicant no.1 Subodh Kumar being real son of co-accused Smt. Annapurna who executed sale deed in favour of six persons despite injunction order passed by the Civil Judge Junior Division and received amount of Rs. 12 lacs at the time of agreement to sell and without making repayment to the informant, sale deeds were executed without any notice to the informant and depriving him of the property.
Applicants cannot be said to have worked in good faith.

Further urged that charge sheet has been submitted by the police on the basis of which cognizance was taken in the year 2021 even though applicants are not appearing before the learned court but avoiding the process of the trial, therefore they are not entitled for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record and without making any comment on the merit of the case, there appears no ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of the applicants.

The anticipatory bail application of applicants Subodh Kumar and Surendra Singh involved in Case Crime No. 610 of 2018, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120-B IPC, P.S. Chhibramau, District Kannauj is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 A. Singh  Subodh Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151221573/
